title: Composition-Supported Typographic Role Grammar / Reflow
question: Can a responsive typographic role grammar add distinctive but subordinate Kymaean character and clearer hierarchy inside the compatible C0 + MAT F1 + STA F2 scaffold across APP/WEB, 320px, 200% text resize and text-spacing stress, without bespoke glyphs, wordmark dependence, color identity, imagery, real product semantics, or requiring typography to carry identity alone?
orthogonality_to_typ01: No TYP-01 scored family is repaired or reused as a candidate.
TYP-01 tested strong identity independence; TYP-02 tests subordinate contribution inside an existing compatible scaffold.
TYP-02 freezes responsive/reflow behavior prospectively instead of prohibiting all narrow adaptation.
The WCAG/reflow floors remain unchanged or stronger; no accessibility floor is relaxed.
scored_context_scaffold: exact C0 Threshold K currentColor geometry
STA F2 Ring + Edge Witness selected-state grammar

CNEG.name: Neutral Utility
CNEG.primary_mechanism: balanced low-delta system hierarchy with no authored identity claim

F1.name: Ratio Ladder
F1.primary_mechanism: role distinction primarily through a bounded modular size ratio; weight/tracking/measure/rhythm remain near-neutral
F1.primary_risk: generic editorial scale or identity competition with C0

F2.name: Weight Plane
F2.primary_mechanism: role distinction primarily through weight contrast at tightly bounded sizes; measure/rhythm remain near-neutral
F2.primary_risk: generic dashboard hierarchy or excessive heaviness

F3.name: Measure Plane
F3.primary_mechanism: role distinction primarily through controlled text measure and grouping while size/weight deltas remain modest
F3.primary_risk: layout trick rather than transferable typography; fragile line-break dependence

F4.name: Rhythm Plane
F4.primary_mechanism: role distinction primarily through vertical interval cadence and grouping while size/weight/measure remain modest
F4.primary_risk: generic editorial whitespace or fatigue under repeated use

browser_matrix.note: Mechanical matrix may combine equivalent stresses efficiently, but each listed stress must be independently represented and attributable.

accessibility_floors.reflow: 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling for nonessential content
accessibility_floors.text_spacing: line-height >=1.5x, paragraph spacing >=2x font size where applicable, letter spacing +0.12em, word spacing +0.16em stress must not clip/overflow
accessibility_floors.focus_state: selected witness and keyboard focus remain distinguishable independent of typography family

isolation: system-ui, Segoe UI, sans-serif fixture stack only
no downloaded/custom font or font-feature novelty
no bespoke glyphs, ligature invention or altered letterforms
no CLR-01 color, Mineral Theater hue/material role, gradients, texture, imagery or hero composition
no motion as a scored differentiator
subjective_falsification: family is not materially distinguishable from CNEG in hierarchy/character
family competes with C0 or MAT carrier instead of remaining subordinate
APP and WEB read as unrelated typographic systems
distinctiveness depends primarily on accidental line breaks or one viewport
family reads as generic magazine/SaaS/dashboard styling without Kymaean-specific restraint
state labels or supporting content lose clarity/scannability
family becomes fatiguing or theatrically over-authored in repeated low-density use
judgment depends on unresolved color/typeface/wordmark rather than the frozen role grammar

result_law.pass: One or more families survive every mechanical/accessibility floor and subjective falsification criterion; survivors remain provisional role-grammar evidence only.
result_law.zero_survivor: Close TYP-02 with typography still unresolved; do not repair/replace candidates after exposure.
result_law.multiple_survivors: If multiple materially valid survivors remain and distinction is irreducibly aesthetic/product-semantic, trigger Director taste gate.

authority_limits: No final typeface or production typography tokens.
No O3/wordmark redesign or bespoke glyph work.
No CLR-01 reentry or color/material-role convergence.
No source-packet retune, real product UI, app/site implementation, final identity or Phase-C convergence.

review_law.principle: Accessibility/stress modes are pass/fail validation and never aesthetic alternatives. Subjective review occurs only after complete mechanical pass.

control_law: CNEG is an ineligible calibration control and can never survive TYP-02
